name: AUSNet Services
summary: Sydney corporate ISP & systems integrator (est. 1994; world.net service); original ISP gone by ~2000s, ausnet.net.au later reused; unrelated to the Victorian electricity/gas network AUSNet Services (AUSNET SERVICES LTD).

events.details: Corporate ISP & systems integrator, Level 10 Norwich House, 6-10 O'Connell St, Sydney; 'world.net' service (sales@world.net). Established 1994 per its own about page.

Original ISP gone; domain reused by Kempsey operator from 2015. Best-supported death is by Dec 1998 (folded to Microplex/Optus), tightening both the current 'c. 2000s' and the proposal's 2000 endpoint beside its c. 1998-2000 range. AUSNet homepage redirected to Microplex's home.mpx.com.au; Optus had acquired Microplex in May 1998; domain served Optus Internet by May 2000.

refs.label: By 12 Dec 1998 AUSNet's own homepage was a plain pointer to Microplex — the brand's independent web presence ended here
AFR 25 May 1998: the host AUSNet moved to was itself swallowed by Optus in 1998
By May 2000 ausnet.net.au served an Optus Internet portal — original ISP fully absorbed

events.details: Name collision only: the unrelated Victorian electricity/gas network operator AUSNet Services (AUSNET SERVICES (DISTRIBUTION) PTY LTD, ACN 108 788 245, VIC, registered 1 Oct 2004) shares the name but is a different entity, not this Sydney ISP.

refs.label: ABR: AUSNET SERVICES (DISTRIBUTION) PTY LTD ACN 108 788 245 (VIC electricity network — NAME COLLISION, not this ISP)
